Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant MSc degree within molecular biology, plant or agricultural sciences, biology, biotechnology or similar.

PhD Position in Environmental Genomics and Pollinator Ecology
Ecoscience
Applicants to the PhD position should have a master’s degree in ecology, biology, environmental science, bioinformatics, genomics, conservation biology or a related discipline.

PhD Position in Computational Mass Spectrometry Imaging and Spatial Metabolomics
Environmental Science
We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research. Applicants should hold a master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics/ cheminformatics, AI/ML, data science, chemistry, computational biology, chemometrics, analytical chemistry or a related discipline.

PhD Position in Physical AI: Adaptive Foundation Models for Robotics
Electrical and Computer Engineering

Informed comfort: natural-language interaction with home heating and cooling
Civil and Architectural Engineering
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a M.Sc. in engineering, computer science, building science or a related technical field.
2026/11/01 23:59 CET
Tracking Microbes Across Borders using Genomics to Uncover Biomass-to-Biogas Transmission Pathways
Animal and Veterinary Sciences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant master’s degree, or an equivalent qualification, in Genomics, veterinary science, microbiology, molecular biology, bioinformatics, or a closely related discipline.
2026/12/01 23:59 CET
Carbon flux and particle export along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland’s coastal ocean
Ecoscience
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree and have demonstrated interest and background in biogeochemistry, for example through a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, research project, internship, or other relevant research experience.
2026/11/30 23:59 CET
Integrating Hormonal and Biomechanical Stimuli in Multi-scale Modelling of human Vascular cells
Mechanical and Production Engineering
We are looking for highly motivated and independent candidates with the intention to complete a 3-year PhD at Aarhus University. Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanical Engineering, Biotechnology or relevant fields.
